html-shape--blank-line-br.why:
a blank line


shows as TWO lines in the editor (trailing hard break); midst-editor #15

html-shape--empty-paragraph-no-br.why:
empty

has zero height in a browser (midst-editor #15)

html-shape--trailing-br.why:
a trailing
adds a line in the editor, not in a browser; midst-editor #15

synthetic--rangy-span.why: a selection-marker span outside any paragraph becomes its own paragraph (midst-editor #15)

synthetic--tabs.why: DEPENDS on the old app's white-space, which is not established: under 'normal' (used here) a tab-only line is zero height, so the editor shows 1 more; under pre-wrap the raw newline line breaks, so the editor shows 1 fewer. midst-editor #17
